name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: A library of ready-made 'skill packs' that teach an AI assistant how a specific job actually works — like a lawyer's, accountant's, or marketer's — so it produces finished work in that profession's own style instead of generic output.
buyer: An operations lead at a professional-services firm (law, accounting, marketing agency) who wants their team's AI output to follow firm-specific process and tone without building that themselves.
business_use_cases: An agency builds and sells industry-specific plugin packs (e.g. a 'real-estate broker pack') to firms using Claude Cowork or Claude Code.
A consultancy customizes a plugin to match a client's exact intake and QA workflow as a paid implementation engagement.
An internal ops team builds one company-specific plugin and rolls it out firm-wide so every employee's AI output is consistent.

money_ideas.idea: Sell custom plugin-development and rollout consulting to professional-services firms
Run a marketplace of paid, vertical-specific plugin packs

steal_this: Pick one profession this weekend, build a polished plugin for it, publish it, and offer paid setup/customization to firms in that niche.
